name: Luminar
summary:
Luminar is an immersive mixed reality web browser with real-time lighting effects to enhance your experience.

Unleash the full potential of your living room as it transforms into a dynamic, personalized digital hub. Effortlessly browse the web, watch videos, stream from your desktop, and more. Tailor your experience by adjusting screen and lighting settings to match your preferences and create the perfect ambiance.

Luminar is currently in Beta, and will continually be updated with new features and improve
